note: Bitbucket Pipelines is a CI/CD feature of Bitbucket Cloud, itself a product line within publicly traded Atlassian Corporation (NASDAQ: TEAM). Atlassian was co-founded in 2002 by Mike Cannon-Brookes and Scott Farquhar, bootstrapped for years (financed initially via a $10,000 credit card debt), took a $60M secondary VC sale from Accel Partners in 2010 (existing-shareholder liquidity, not primary company funding), and IPO'd in December 2015. Revenue/employee figures are for the whole of Atlassian, not Bitbucket Pipelines specifically.
